questions.q: According to the summary, what does dharma mean for an individual?
a: Their calling and the way their life should naturally unfold
The wealth a person accumulates over a lifetime
The ritual duties assigned by birth and social class
The emotional attachments that bind us to other people
questions.why: Lesson 1 defines dharma as the nature of reality and, for a person, their call and the way their life is meant to occur.

questions.q: What does the summary say happens when you follow someone else's dharma instead of your own?
a: It brings pain and regret
It brings peace but little joy
It speeds up your self-discovery
It has no effect on your happiness
questions.why: Lesson 1 warns that ignoring your own path hurts your soul, and that living someone else's path causes pain and regret.

questions.q: How does the summary recommend approaching the goals you are working toward?
a: Find meaning in the journey instead of fixating on the final prize
Set the biggest possible goal and ignore daily tasks
Wait for the perfect moment before starting anything
Judge each day only by how close you are to the end
questions.why: Lesson 2 argues that constant anticipation makes life harder to enjoy, and that wisdom lies in finding happiness right now.

questions.q: What does meditation train you to do, according to the summary?
a: Control your mind and focus attention on what matters most
Suppress every emotion and desire permanently
Escape the present moment and live in your imagination
Memorize religious texts more quickly and accurately
questions.why: Lesson 3 describes meditation as stopping negative thoughts and training your attention on what matters, which helps you stay focused on your dharma.

questions.q: What does the summary call the purpose of the human journey?
a: Discovering who you are and fulfilling your calling
Accumulating enough wealth to end daily struggle
Renouncing the world so you can avoid suffering
Meeting other people's expectations as fully as possible
questions.why: The overview says our purpose is to discover who we are and kill our demons while fulfilling our calling.
